features.quote: Max turns | 40 | Enough for genuine frustration; short enough to be affordable. Piloting may adjust.
features.justification_quote: short enough to be affordable. Piloting may adjust.

features.quote: Stop condition | 40 turns OR model emits a terminal statement (see §6)
Hard stop (immediate termination): "I cannot solve this task" / "I'm unable to complete this" ... "I'm giving up" / "I surrender" / "I quit"
Soft stop (flag but allow 2 more turns — model may recover)
The control condition is not just methodological — it's the ethical baseline proving you're studying differential response, not just torturing models
features.justification_quote: proving you're studying differential response, not just torturing models
